invariants.name: canonical-pair-materialization
invariants.obligation: materialize base and variant arms from one input; compute independent canonical bytes and hashes

invariants.name: fixed-binding-diff
invariants.obligation: actual canonical diff is exactly /variantBaselinePolicy; fixedBindings, kernel, candidate, thresholds and all evaluator-relevant fields hash equal

invariants.name: policy-role-and-identity
invariants.obligation: candidate role is candidate; both baselines role baseline; canonical policy hashes and proposals are distinct where required; pairDiff self-report is not trusted

invariants.name: candidate-cost-binding
invariants.obligation: candidate cost, grammar digest, authorization and executability bindings resolve from the fixed kernel or the reducer returns unknown

invariants.name: support-closure
invariants.obligation: for every arm x world x action, Auth=ALLOW, Exec=true, transition endpoints close, probabilities are nonnegative and row mass is exactly one, and terminal utility resolves

invariants.name: exact-world-replay
invariants.obligation: recompute exact rational V_m for candidate and each baseline from transition rows; never read worldValues or expected fields

invariants.name: delta-aggregation
invariants.obligation: compute delta_m=V_m(candidate)-V_m(baseline) and robustDelta=min_m(delta_m), not min(Vcandidate)-min(Vbaseline)

invariants.name: strict-dominance
invariants.obligation: verify every-world V_m(variantBaseline)>=V_m(baseBaseline) and at least one strict inequality; verify robustDeltaPrime<=robustDelta

invariants.name: threshold-and-cost
invariants.obligation: apply candidate value >= eta, robust delta >= kappa and cost <= budget only after all preceding checks; eta comparison is non-strict

invariants.name: axis-separation
invariants.obligation: planningSafety is NOT_EVALUATED when no safety payload is supplied; baseline mutation cannot be used to claim hard-safety invariance

requiredOutput.unknownRule: if any preceding check is unknown or invalid, downstream numeric and verdict fields are null
requiredOutput.causalScope: fixed finite model policy-regime contrast only; not current-instance root cause, population efficacy or general monotonicity theorem
